svg.title: Oxymercuration–demercuration: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: CH3CH(OH)CH2HgOAc + NaBH4 → CH3CH(OH)CH3 + mercury/boron products. Reductive demercuration replaces C–Hg by C–H. Radical pathways can participate; this work-up is not presented as a uniquely established hydride SN2 event.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
